skills.name: You're All Under Arrest!

skills.detail:
A close-range area attack with a chance to inflict Counter.

When Counter Succeeds:
If enemy attacks within a set period of time, deals a long-range area attack with a Knockback effect and a chance to inflict Capture Block. Also, HP will be recovered. Acquires SPD debuff effect at Level 5.

When Counter Fails:
If the enemy does not attack within a set period of time, HP will be recovered. Become temporarily invincible after use.
